sources.note: Nothing about stress; it is a code-retirement request. p.2: 'No known evidence exists that Warduji is a language.. We have been unable to identify a single speaker either at the present time or in the past.' The only 'Warduji' recordings (Global Recordings Network C17771) 'was verified as Shughni by a native Shughni speaker'; people from Warduj District say the local speech is 'just Dari with a slight local flavor'. Section (c) 'Knowledge from published sources' is empty: no published source exists.
